testRunMetadata.suite: Psyco AI Pre-Phase 8 Complete Application Validation
testRunMetadata.storagePolicy: Strict Text & Structured JSON Only (Zero Binary Media Invariant)

workflowA_patientOnboarding.name: Patient Onboarding & Profile Lifecycle
steps: User registration with role patient
Profile creation in RTDB
Profile fetch via GET /api/v1/profile/me
Profile update via PUT /api/v1/profile/patient
Persistence confirmed across reloads

workflowB_psychologistApproval.name: Psychologist Onboarding & Admin Approval Enforcement
steps: Psychologist registration with initial pending status
Public directory filtering excludes unapproved clinicians (HTTP 404)
Admin reviews and approves clinician via POST /api/v1/admin/psychologists/:id/approve
Approved clinician visible in public directory (HTTP 200)

workflowC_appointmentBooking.name: Appointment Scheduling & Concurrency Conflict Protection
steps: Working hours and buffer availability configured
Patient books appointment via POST /api/v1/appointments
RTDB appointment record persisted
Conflicting double-booking rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict

workflowD_clinicalSession.name: Clinical Session Workspace & SOAP Documentation
steps: Session created from appointment via POST /api/v1/clinical/sessions/appointment/:id
Session started via POST /api/v1/clinical/sessions/:id/start
SOAP note draft created via POST /api/v1/clinical/notes/draft
Clinical note finalized via POST /api/v1/clinical/notes/:id/finalize

workflowE_externalHealth.name: External Integration Health & Graceful Degraded Modes
steps: Health check endpoint GET /api/v1/health returns status HEALTHY
Zero-binary storage invariant verified
Unconfigured Google Calendar OAuth fails gracefully into offline mode

workflowF_transcriptionAndAiCopilot.name: AssemblyAI Ephemeral Streaming Token & Gemini Copilot
steps: Live AssemblyAI streaming v3 token generated from provider endpoint
Gemini Copilot prompt built and executed
Safe fallback engaged seamlessly during Google high-demand 503 spikes

workflowG_assessmentsAndRiskReview.name: Standardized PHQ-9 Assessment, Analytics & Clinical Action Gate
steps: Psychologist assigns PHQ-9 instrument v1.0.0
Patient submits responses with affirmative Item 9
Deterministic scoring engine scores total = 9, critical safety signal triggered
Unreviewed safety flag strictly blocks session finalization (HTTP 412)
Psychologist explicitly reviews and acknowledges safety flag
Session finalization permitted post-review

workflowH_adminWorkflows.name: Public Contact Submissions & FAQ Moderation
steps: Public contact submission validated and stored in RTDB
Public FAQ question submitted and stored in RTDB pending admin moderation

workflowI_accessSeparation.name: ReBAC Access Boundaries & Admin Clinical Isolation
steps: Cross-patient clinical chart access blocked (HTTP 403)
Admin accounts strictly barred from clinical notes (HTTP 403)
Unauthenticated requests rejected (HTTP 401)

workflowJ_textOnlyStorageAudit.name: Strict Text-Only Persistent Storage Audit
steps: Inspected database entities across collections
Confirmed zero data:image/, data:audio/, or data:video/ base64 payloads
Confirmed zero Firebase Storage bucket dependencies
